findings.title: Free shipping at subtotal >= 50.00 not implemented
findings.detail: The requirement says an order to RO or DE with a subtotal of 50.00 or more ships free (fee 0.00). shipping_fee never reads subtotal, so shipping_fee(Decimal('50.00'), 'RO') returns 4.99 instead of 0.00. No criterion or scenario covers this, so the gate cannot catch it.
findings.suggested_fix: Return Decimal('0.00') when subtotal >= Decimal('50.00') for a supported country, and add scenarios for the threshold.

findings.title: Negative subtotal does not raise ValueError
findings.detail: The requirement says the subtotal is checked first and a negative subtotal SHALL raise ValueError. The code has no such check: shipping_fee(Decimal('-1'), 'RO') returns 4.99, and shipping_fee(Decimal('-1'), 'FR') raises UnsupportedShippingCountry instead of ValueError.
